results.title: Candidates night slated for Oct. 6
results.description: A candidates’ night for local office is scheduled for Tuesday, Oct. 6 at the Fallon Convention Center. Fallon’s two newspapers, the Lahontan Valley News and Fallon Post, and Lahontan Broadcasting Co., have sponsored candidates night since the 2020 pandemic when residents couldn’t attend the forum in person.
